hook: Your taxi has no driver at all.
title: This Taxi Has Nobody In The Driver's Seat
description:
Waymo's robotaxis carry passengers with nobody in the driver's seat, and the steering wheel turns by itself. They use cameras, lidar and radar to read the road.

Series: Tech That Sounds Fake.
comment_prompt: Would you ride it? Yes or no
